drhp.business: The Company operates out of its single standalone hospitality property at Chembur, Mumbai, offering Exclusive Multi-Cuisine Pure Vegetarian food through its restaurants and banquets, which cater to celebrations and business/leisure travel demand. During FY2025-26 the Company activated a new Real Estate business segment, with cumulative investment of Rs.35.61 crores in this segment as on 31 March 2026, though it has not yet contributed revenue.

risks.note: The Company operates out of its single standalone hospitality property located at Chembur, Mumbai, with no other operating property disclosed, exposing revenue to single-site/single-market concentration.

The Real Estate segment was only activated in FY2025-26 and recorded no revenue for the year; the Chembur project has received only an LOI while the Mahim project remains under consolidation, so approvals, funding (financial closure) and start-up timelines for both are still pending.

Management explicitly notes that the business continues to be influenced by the global geopolitical situation, overall economic growth, tourism trends and general business sentiment prevailing in the market.

The cautionary statement flags slowdown in India's economic growth, inflation, war, changes in Government Regulations and tax laws, and factors such as litigation and labour relations as risks that could cause actual results to differ from forward-looking statements.
risks.risk: Broad regulatory, tax and litigation risk

risks.note: The Board/Management continuously review strategic, operational, financial, credit, market, liquidity, legal, regulatory and cybersecurity risks under the Risk Management Policy; liquidity and credit risk are live considerations given the Company's continuing operating losses.
risks.risk: Liquidity and credit risk amid continuing losses

risks.note: The Company has remained loss-making at the EBIT/PAT level; although losses narrowed year-on-year, sustained profitability is not yet demonstrated and remains dependent on hospitality demand recovery and the untested Real Estate segment.

sk.overview: The overnight ocean and coastal cruise industry in India is a nascent, high-growth segment of cruise tourism.
